ConnectionStrings.Aspire__Comment: Running Bit.TemplatePlayground.Server.AppHost overrides the following connection strings, but including them here provides two benefits:
ConnectionStrings.Aspire__Comment_1: Most Aspire resources use Docker, but if team members run Server.Api or Server.Web directly without Docker or wanna using dev tunnels inside Visual Studio, these connection strings ensure functionality.
ConnectionStrings.Aspire__Comment_2: The Bit.TemplatePlayground.Tests project runs Server.Web and Server.Api directly, bypassing Aspire, to allow replacing app's registered service in tests, enhancing the test-writing experience. These connection strings are also used by the integration API and UI tests.
ConnectionStrings.SqliteConnectionString_Comment: To debug inside docker, change ConnectionStrings__SqliteConnectionString's value in launchSettings.json
ConnectionStrings.ConnectionStrings_Comment: The ConnectionStrings section contains database connection strings used by the application.

OpenAI.ChatApiKey_Comment: Get one at https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new More info at https://github.com/marketplace/models
OpenAI.EmbeddingApiKey_Comment: Get one at https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new More info at https://github.com/marketplace/models

Identity.BearerTokenExpiration_Comment: BearerTokenExpiration used as JWT's expiration claim, access token's expires in and cookie's max age. Format: D.HH:mm:ss
Identity.MaxPrivilegedSessionsCount_Comment: Is the maximum number of concurrent privileged sessions a user can have.

Email.Host_Comment: Local folder means storing emails as .eml file in App_Data/sent-emails folder (Recommended for testing purposes only) instead of sending them using smtp server.

Email__Comment: You can also use https://ethereal.email/create for testing purposes.
GoogleRecaptchaSecretKey_Comment: Create one at https://console.cloud.google.com/security/recaptcha/create for Web Application Type and use site key in Client.Core

Apple.ClientId_Comment: Your Service Id's Identifier such as com.adminpanel.bitplatform.dev

TrustedOrigins_Comment: Lists the permitted origins for CORS requests, return URLs following social sign-in and email confirmation, etc., along with allowed origins for Web Auth.

ForwardedHeaders.ForwardedHeaders_Comment: These values apply only if your backend is hosted behind a CDN (such as `Cloudflare`).
ForwardedHeaders.ForwardedHostHeaderName_Comment: For Cloudflare, use X-Host instead of X-Forwarded-Host.

Cloudflare.AdditionalDomains_Comment: The ResponseCacheService clears the cache for the current domain by default. If multiple Cloudflare-hosted domains point to your backend, you will need to purge the cache for each of them individually.

WebAppRender.PrerenderEnabled_Comment: for apps with Prerender enabled, follow the instructions in the Client.Web/wwwroot/service-worker.published.js file

SupportedAppVersions.SupportedAppVersions__Comment: Enabling `AutoReload` (Disabled by default) ensure the latest app version is always applied in Web & Windows apps. Refer to `Client.Web/Components/AppBswupProgressBar.razor`, `Client.Web/wwwroot/index.html` and `Client.Windows/appsettings.json` for details.
